button.label: Changes
button.title: What you changed and what is not sent yet

title: Changes

state.cloningLead: Your changes will appear when it is ready.
state.connectTitle: Could not connect to the repository
state.connectLead: Check the address and access in the list of spaces.

intro: Only you can see these edits for now. To reach students, they have to be sent for review.

empty.title: No changes yet
empty.draft: Open a document and press “Change conditions” or “Document text”. Everything you edit will be collected here.
empty.released: Version {{version}} is released and cannot change. Make a copy with “Edit a copy” and edit the copy.

folder.title: Your edits are already written to the folder.
folder.lead: This space has no sending: save and send changes the way you usually work with this folder. Connect a repository to send from here.

checks.title: Checks
checks.warnings_one: {{count}} formatting remark. It does not block sending.
checks.warnings_few: {{count}} formatting remarks. They do not block sending.
checks.warnings_many: {{count}} formatting remarks. They do not block sending.
checks.warnings_other: {{count}} formatting remarks. They do not block sending.
checks.notes: Describe what changed for students and supervisors: the version cannot be released without it. This is a normal step, not an error.

request.openLead: Now it is up to the repository maintainers: they will review the changes and accept them into the main branch.
request.awaiting: Waiting for approval: GitHub does not run checks for a new contributor until a maintainer allows it
request.unknown: Check status is unknown: the hosting does not report it
request.nextClean: You can keep editing: new changes will go into the same request.
request.nextEdits: There are edits that are not in the request yet. When you send them, they go into the same request.
request.mergedLead: The changes are in the main branch, students get them with the next Studio release.
request.mergedNext: Your branch is not needed anymore: a new edit starts from the fresh main branch.
request.closedLead: The changes did not reach the main branch. You can reset your changes and start clean.

where.branch: Working branch (the line of your changes): {{branch}}.
where.ahead: Saved points ahead of the main branch: {{count}}.
where.noBranch: The edits are only yours for now: nothing has been sent to the repository.

behind.title: The main branch has news.
behind.lead: Take them so that the request does not conflict.
behind.done: News from the main branch taken
behind.upToDate: Nothing new in the main branch

menu.label: More about changes
menu.take: Take news from the main branch
